experimental_unit: one fixed freshstack query run against the model-token index, raw and instructed

controlled_variables.index: exp 25 model-token candidate index held fixed (preserved at ~/Development/DATA/omrg/experiments/exp25-lancedb); read-only, nothing is ingested
controlled_variables.chunking: model-token Markdown chunker (ADR-063), already the packaged default; its build cost is exp 25's verified 0.974906 request-token ratio and is not re-measured
controlled_variables.ocr_routing: not exercised — the FreshStack corpus contains no PDFs; the OCR component of the candidate path is evidenced by experiment 24 on a disjoint corpus
controlled_variables.retrieval: hybrid (BM25 + dense, RRF k=60), rerank disabled, top_k 50

reference_cells.role: the production-shaped baseline every quality gate is stated against; loaded, never re-run
the fourth cell of the 2x2; loaded, never re-run

validity_gates.basis: production baseline 0.255884 minus the paired bootstrap 95% half-width 0.024838 = 0.231046. Identical basis and value to experiment 25's frozen quality gate, so the combined path is held to the same non-inferiority bar as the single-factor arm that was promoted

production baseline 0.278862 minus paired bootstrap 95% half-width 0.020571 = 0.258291. Identical to the frozen regression gate in experiments 25 and 26: fewer, fuller chunks and an instruction preamble both tax exact-token recall first, and stacking them is the case this experiment exists to test

identical to the frozen latency limit in experiments 25 and 26 (1.5 x baseline p95 1984.2 ms, clearing the baseline p95 estimator CI upper bound 2334.3 ms). Latency is cloud-inclusive; the two arms must be interleaved to control network drift

monitored_non_gating.reason: the 2x2 is assembled from runs on two indexes and three dates, so the interaction term carries cross-run drift as well as signal; it is recorded and inspected, never gated

a fixed instruction preamble more than doubles a short query's token count by construction, so a ratio gate here would test arithmetic rather than a design risk. The absolute spend is roughly twenty tokens per query against a 22,281-chunk index build; it is recorded for the task 5.4 cost record
bootstrap 95% half-width is 0.15 at n=20 (gate_noise.json); any hard gate would be noise
